user.title: FordPass China
user.description: Choose an authentication method. Since 2026 Ford China uses DLT tokens; the refresh_token in transit is white-box AES ciphertext, so a plaintext refresh_token can't be captured. Recommended: grab the auth-token (DLT access token) from the app's request headers.

dlt.title: Authenticate with DLT access token (2026)
dlt.description: Open the FordPass app and trigger a vehicle status refresh, then capture the request to cnapi.cv.ford.com.cn and copy the value of the auth-token request header. See README.

token.title: Authenticate with refresh_token (legacy)
token.description: Paste the refresh_token captured from the FordPass app. Note: in the 2026 app this value is encrypted; if you cannot capture it, use the DLT access token method instead.

account.title: Authenticate with account/password
account.description: Note: Ford China migrated the SSO; this method usually does not work. Use the DLT access token instead.

error.cant_auth: Could not read user info with this token: invalid or expired, please capture a new one
error.cant_login: Account login failed: auth rejected (use the DLT access token instead)

init.title: FordPass China options
init.description: Set the vehicle status polling interval (minutes). Note: too-frequent polling may trigger Ford risk control.
